request.deadline: Instantly as part of governance action enactment on-chain
deliverables: Reimburse the claimed 100,000 ADA lost governance action deposit
Pay an additional 3,000 ADA for claimed lost staking rewards
Distribute funds directly on-chain to the intended recipient upon enactment
request.recipient: Ikigai Info governance action submitter / intended recipient; specific identity or address not stated in document
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to reimburse the lost Ikigai Info governance action deposit and claimed lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: An Info governance action titled Cardanoの生きがい - Ikigai - was submitted in September 2024 shortly after the Chang hard fork.
The Ikigai Info governance action was symbolic and asked the community to agree with a statement thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano's future.
A Cardano node bug permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action, preventing the submitter from recovering the 100,000 ADA deposit.
The proposer says there was significant community sentiment that the submitter should be reimbursed for the lost deposit.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included this reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that action was not approved.
The requested 103,000 ADA consists of the original 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA for claimed lost staking rewards calculated at 2% per annum.
The recipient has not previously received funds from the Cardano treasury.
The requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The funds would be made directly available to the intended recipient and the distribution would be auditable on-chain.

summary: The document requests 103,000 ADA to reimburse a claimed unrecoverable 100,000 ADA governance action deposit and 3,000 ADA in claimed lost staking rewards, with direct on-chain distribution to the original submitter.
